title: AI-Integrated Skin-on-Chip and Smart Biomaterials for Chronic Wound Drug Discovery: Evidence-Mapping Data and Reproducibility Code
description: Research data and reproducibility package accompanying the review Emerging AI-Integrated Skin-on-Chip and Smart Biomaterial Platforms for Chronic Wound Drug Discovery. Includes a curated reference registry, study-level coding datasets, evidence matrices, source-data workbook, Python scripts, eleven supplementary figure outputs, validation reports, and documentation. This resource supports descriptive evidence mapping and reproducibility, not independent experimental or clinical validation.
